newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,433 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 1,433 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural trading volume totaled 1,433 contracts compared with 1,018 overnight Monday.
There were 182 wheat, 389 corn, 721 soybean, 25 soymeal, 96 soyoil, three oat, one wheat call, two wheat puts, three corn calls, nine soybean calls and two soybean puts traded.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1-3/4 to 2-1/2 cents lower, corn was steady to 3/4 cent lower and soybeans were two to four cents lower.
